# Josephine Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** presumed seventy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Josephine Barry is a thin, prim, and rigid old woman with wrinkled cheeks. She wears gold-rimmed glasses, through which her sharp black eyes often snap or twinkle.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031)_

## Personality

A prim, proper, and critical old lady, Josephine Barry is known for her rather selfish nature and a terrible temper that is no joke when aroused. Despite these formidable qualities, she is a most hospitable host who treats her guests royally once they gain her favor.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008)_

## History

Aunt Josephine Barry was an elderly woman who was infuriated when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) accidentally jumped on her while she was sleeping in the spare bed at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), prompting her to threaten to leave and end Diana's music lessons. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visited her to apologize, Josephine was won over by the girl's candor and imagination, deciding to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) became close friends. She later hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at her grand [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) home during the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition) and subsequently welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood) while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P51](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0051), [v1 CHAPTER XVI. ## Quotes

> "Mercy, child, how you have grown! You’re taller than I am, I declare. And you’re ever so much better-looking than you used to be, too. But I dare say you know that without being told."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P18](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0018)

> "I dare say your claim to sympathy is just as strong as mine. It all depends on the way we look at it. Sit down here and tell me about yourself."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P88](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0088)

> "Remember, you Anne-girl, when you come to town you’re to visit me and I’ll put you in my very sparest spare-room bed to sleep."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P96](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0096)

> "Oh, I must, hey? I rather think Diana did her share of the jumping at least. Such carryings on in a respectable house!"
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082)

> "She amuses me, and at my time of life an amusing person is a rarity."
>
> — Josephine Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P92](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0092)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josephine-barry.md)

Josephine Barry considers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to be a prime favorite, and the two enjoy spending time together when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her and attends church with her. Their friendship began after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bravely took the blame for accidentally jumping onto Josephine in bed, winning her over with her candor and vivid imagination. Josephine was so charmed by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she canceled her plans to leave [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and later hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) at her grand home in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

- Friend of — prime favorite who visits and goes to church with her  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P31](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P16](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0016), +1 more</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--josephine-barry.md)

[Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) is Josephine Barry's niece. Josephine frequently interacts with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), such as hostessing both girls for a fun-filled visit to her home in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) during the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). She also previously provided [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) with music lessons.

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI.
